test.description: Native contour source at the fractional zoom 12.6, above the raster-dem maxzoom 12. Since maplibre-native#4650 a raster-dem source rounds its covering zoom, while other sources floor it; a contour source must cover the same tiles as the raster-dem source it reads, or its tiles find no DEM tile and stay empty. Centred on the corner where four z=12 DEM tiles meet, so lines must be present and continuous across both tile boundaries.
